title: PCC: Pivotal Channel Compensation for Layer Pruning of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Treating independent layers as the minimal pruning unit allows layer pruning to efficiently eliminate many redundant parameters and achieve high compression rates. Layer pruning has become a promising and prevalent structured pruning technique for large language models (LLMs). However, multi-layer removal can lead to significant performance degradation for LLMs. Although some works have explored various compensation methods for pruned layers, they are inefficient and costly. Observing that the expression of a large proportion of information is concentrated on a small number of pivotal channels, we propose a novel post-pruning compensation method for layer pruning, called pivotal channel compensation (PCC). PCC can achieve significant performance improvement by compensating for a small number of channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface. translated_title: PCC：面向大语言模型层剪枝的关键通道补偿
translated_abstract: 将独立的层作为最小剪枝单元，使层剪枝能够高效消除大量冗余参数并实现高压缩率，层剪枝已成为大语言模型（LLM）中一种有前景且流行的结构化剪枝技术。然而，移除多层会导致大语言模型性能显著下降。尽管已有一些工作探索了针对被剪枝层的各种补偿方法，但它们效率低下且成本高昂。我们观察到大部分信息的表达集中在少数关键通道上，据此提出了一种新颖的层剪枝后补偿方法，称为关键通道补偿（PCC）。PCC 通过在剪枝接口处对少量关键通道进行可学习的线性变换补偿，能够实现显著的性能提升。此外，我们还提出了一个新的评估指标，称为通道级平均……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出关键通道补偿（PCC）方法，通过在剪枝接口处仅对少量关键通道施加可学习的线性变换，以低成本显著恢复大语言模型层剪枝后的性能。
en_tdlr: We propose Pivotal Channel Compensation (PCC), a novel post-pruning method that significantly improves the performance of layer-pruned LLMs by compensating only a small number of pivotal channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface.
